verdict.rationale: Ente Auth has a sync server and an official CLI, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no versioned public API and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe found nothing at every candidate path, and the changelog and CLI evidence say nothing about API versioning or deprecation timelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
